integrity: The result is proved from the exact characteristic roots and a phase-crossing argument. The packaged checker uses exact rational recurrence arithmetic for representative cases and numerical asymptotic cross-checks; finite checks are corroborative rather than an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact first-sign-loss law is for fixed-step scalar decay with one backward Euler starter step. It does not cover variable steps, other starters, nonlinear equations, or coupled systems. The classical positivity threshold h lambda <= 1/2 is prior work, not part of the originality claim.
title: Exact delayed sign loss just beyond BDF2's positivity boundary
